The playbook's target onboarding range for the Enterprise plan is **8 to 10 weeks** [NL-005#NL-005-S02] [NL-031#NL-031-S02] [NL-009#NL-009-S04] [NL-023#NL-023-S06]. The observed Enterprise average is **8.7 weeks** [NL-012#NL-012-S06] [NL-031#NL-031-S03], which falls squarely within (and in fact matches) the target timeline—the actual median duration for Enterprise is recorded as 8.7 weeks against the 8-10 week target [NL-031#NL-031-S02].

The observed Enterprise duration is longer than simpler plans (Starter at 3.5 weeks and Growth at 5.2 weeks) because Enterprise onboarding involves substantially more complex compliance, security, and data-processing activities that simpler plans do not require [NL-012#NL-012-S06]. Specifically, Enterprise implementations must accommodate security reviews, custom data-retention configurations, and single sign-on (SSO) setups via SAML/OIDC, as well as process scanned legacy PDF policies requiring OCR [NL-012#NL-012-S06] [NL-005#NL-005-S02]. They also include custom DPAs, nested Active Directory/Okta permission mapping, advanced OCR ingestion queues, BYOK configurations, and up to 3 weeks of formal UAT [NL-005#NL-005-S09] [NL-005#NL-005-S02]. Delays are primarily driven by permission mapping (45%), source ingestion cleanup (30%), and OCR processing (25%) [NL-012#NL-012-S06], and these tasks are necessary to meet the 85% citation correctness threshold and pass internal security reviews before go-live [NL-015#NL-015-S04] [NL-023#NL-023-S06]. In contrast, SMB customers upload clean, public-facing FAQs without complex permissions, and Growth customers have simpler permission structures [NL-012#NL-012-S06].
